action_items: Optional polish: the OSM tile CSS filter 'brightness(0.78) contrast(1.05) saturate(0.85)' in BTLeafletMap dims the map to match the dark theme — verify legibility for users with reduced vision and consider exposing a 'high-contrast tiles' setting.
Optional: snapshot timeout in BTLeafletMap is hard-coded to 8000 ms; on slow mid-range Androids html2canvas can take 10–12 s. Consider bumping to 12 s or making it configurable per call.
Optional (carry-over): /app/backend/buried_treasure.py is still ~1230 lines; the iteration-5 recommendation to split it into bt_solo.py / bt_groups.py / bt_schedule.py is still pending.
critical_code_review_comments: treasure/index.tsx (new): pendingMode + savedArea state machine is sound. The 'no savedArea' branch correctly drops into pickArea instead of dereferencing — directly fixes the previous 'pickedArea.radius_m' null crash.

BTLeafletMap.tsx: HTML is correctly frozen with useMemo([]) so prop changes don't reload Leaflet (which is expensive). useImperativeHandle gives RN clean control over centre/radius/snapshot — good separation.
BTLeafletMap.tsx: snapshotPromises.current uses a per-request id, so concurrent captures don't cross wires. The 8 s timeout cleanup correctly deletes from the registry on both expire and resolve.

BTLeafletMap.tsx: onShouldStartLoadWithRequest whitelists about: and https://localhost/ only — good defence against the WebView opening OSM attribution links in-app. May want to additionally allow tile.openstreetmap.org explicitly if you ever switch from inline HTML to external URL.

BTMapPicker.tsx: the second useEffect (mapReady && !gpsLoading && centre.lat !== AUS_INITIAL.lat) re-centres once the map signals ready — correctly races GPS resolution against WebView boot. Edge case: if a user happens to be at lat=-25.2744 (Australia centroid), the second useEffect won't fire; harmless in practice but worth a comment.
react-native-webview shows the documented 'WebView not supported on this platform' placeholder on web preview — by design per the review brief; not a bug.

Page-load console has many pre-existing 404s on /api/active-boost, /api/boost/inventory, /api/spot/finds — unrelated to this iteration, but worth eventually cleaning up to keep the console signal-to-noise high.
